response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, AVG(f.rebrate / f.feerate) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.avg_ratio) AS avg_of_avg_ratio, SUM(g.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(g.cnt - a.avg_cnt) AS avg_excess FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
